catalyst_observation.source_statement: Topline results from the Phase 3 VOYAGER trial of avapritinib vs. regorafenib in third-/fourth-line advanced GIST: 'VOYAGER did not meet the primary endpoint of an improvement in progression-free survival.' A clean, standalone negative trial-failure headline - the release's other content (continued prioritization of the company's systemic-mastocytosis and RET-altered-cancer programs, cash runway) is standard forward-looking context about unrelated programs, not a reframing of this result. Avapritinib was separately approved the same year for a narrower PDGFRA-exon-18-mutant GIST population (a different, already-positive regulatory track not referenced here); this event concerns only the VOYAGER trial's own negative broader-GIST result.
